name: VST Industries
verdict_headline: Light entry pending full deep-dive research

four_box.note: FY26 cigarette rev +30% YoY/3 qtrs of 10%+ volume growth is a real near-term inflection, but 5yr sales CAGR only 5.7%, 3yr profit growth -4%, div payout 68.4% (yield 5.9%) = mature cash-cow, not a reinvestment growth story (screener.in). ITC dominates 73% share vs VST's ~9% niche/value segment - tam=no on structural industry-size/regulatory-cap math despite only Rs3457cr mkt cap. Moat weak (BAT-affiliated brand + compliance barriers, but distant #3). Valuation yes: cheap at 12.4x P/E, but that reflects sin-stock/tax-risk discount, not market missing the thesis. Score 2.0, no valid exception for a 100x-in-10-years label on a structurally mature/regulated category.
